title.rendered: I Am Chosen Before the Foundation of the World: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: He chose us in Him before the creation of the world to be holy and blameless in His sight. Before the stars. Before the earth. Before time itself. The Father chose you in Christ.

content.rendered:
He chose us in Him before the creation of the world to be holy and blameless in His sight. Before the stars. Before the earth. Before time itself. The Father chose you in Christ. This is the deepest possible truth about your identity.

The Gospel For Today | Saturday, July 4, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“For he chose us in him before the creation of the world to be holy and blameless in his sight. In love.”
Ephesians 1:4 (NIV)

Today’s Message

Paul continues the great doxology of Ephesians 1 with a truth so vast it takes a lifetime to absorb. Before the creation of the world, before there was a “you” in any biological or historical sense, the Father chose you in Christ. The decision was made before time began. The choice was settled before there was a sun to set on it. You are not an afterthought in the universe. You are not an accident of biology. You are not a mistake. You were chosen in Christ before the universe existed.

The Greek word for “chose” is exelexato. It is a strong, deliberate, personal verb. It carries the sense of selecting one out of many with full intent. The Father did not happen to find Himself with the believer in His house. He chose the believer, deliberately, by name, before the foundation of the world. The choice was personal. The choice was loving. The choice was settled long before the believer had any idea that there was a choice to be made.

The purpose of the choice matters as much as the timing. Paul says we were chosen to be holy and blameless in His sight. Not because we already were. To become it through union with Christ. The believer’s holiness is not a credential we bring to God. It is the destination God determined for us before the world began, and the journey is His to complete in us through the indwelling Spirit. The starting point is His choice. The ending point is His glory. The whole arc from beginning to end is held in His hands.

And Paul closes the verse with two of the most important words in the New Testament. In love. The choice was not arbitrary. It was not capricious. It was not a heavenly lottery. The Father chose you in love. The love came first. The love is the reason. The love is the engine that drove the whole plan from before the foundation of the world to this very Saturday morning where you are reading these words.

For Gospelbuzz readers who have ever wondered whether God really wants them, the answer Paul gives is absolute. Before the world existed, He chose you in Christ. In love. He is not putting up with you. He is not tolerating you. He chose you, by name, before time began. Walk in that truth today.

Prayer

Father, I acknowledge that I am chosen in Christ before the creation of the world. You knew me. You chose me. You set Your love on me before there was a sun to rise on my life. I am not an accident. I am not an afterthought. I am the deliberate choice of the Father, made in love and sealed in Christ. I walk in that chosenness today, secure, beloved, and at home in Your purposes. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

I am chosen in Christ before the foundation of the world. The Father chose me in love. I am not an accident. I am beloved by deliberate choice.

Go Deeper in the Word

  • John 15:16: You did not choose me, but I chose you
  • 1 Peter 2:9: You are a chosen people, a royal priesthood
